race.comment: ANDLESS LOVE (4) is worth following up on after making the perfect start at Cairns when leading pillar-to-post. Backs up quickly and with improvement to come she can repeat the dose. Similarly, CASTLE HILL (1) made an immediate impact, scoring on debut at Townsville after stalking the leader. He too has plenty of scope for improvement. STRATEGIC GOLD (3) was fourth behind CASTLE HILL at big odds and draws the inside with a 2kg weight swing in his favour. Gets his chance to turn the tables. BOB'S KOKOPOP (2) also came through that Townsville race, charged home from well back and has the scope to improve into a minor role if he settles closer to the action.
